answer: An operator running 135 keys as a result forfeits for 135 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the canyon salt is published after the comet checkpoint, the basalt audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 201 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
